animations.notes: Animations configured via data-animation attribute on sections/elements. Types: none, fade, scale, slide, clip, flex, fade-up, scale-up. Speed: slow/medium/fast. Body has data-animation-state='booted'.

quirks.description: Squarespace uses ?format=NNNw URL param for responsive images. Available sizes: 100w, 300w, 500w, 750w, 1000w, 1500w, 2500w.
quirks.workaround: Request images with ?format=2500w to get the highest available resolution.

quirks.description: YUI block IDs (block-yui_3_17_2_*) change between requests, making selectors fragile.
quirks.workaround: Use data-section-id and data-sqsp-section attributes for stable identification instead of YUI-generated IDs.

quirks.description: Fluid Engine uses CSS Grid with ~20-24 column tracks and 11px gap. Blocks positioned via grid-column/grid-row. Grid values are viewport-specific.
quirks.workaround: Extract grid styles at each viewport independently. Do not copy grid-template values from one breakpoint to another.

quirks.description: Every section has .section-border > .section-background (both position: absolute) as a full-section backdrop. Content sits in .content-wrapper (position: relative) on top.
quirks.workaround: Do not treat section-border/section-background as visible content. Extract background styles from them but render content from .content-wrapper.

quirks.description: Squarespace 7.1 wraps all content in #siteWrapper > main#page. Probe sees bodyDirectChildSections: 1, triggering isSPA: true. Squarespace is NOT an SPA.
quirks.workaround: spaContainerHints drill into #siteWrapper and main#page to find actual sections.

quirks.description: Gallery sections (data-sqsp-section='gallery') do NOT use Fluid Engine grid. They use gallery-strips layout with gallery-strips-item children.
quirks.workaround: Detect section type via data-sqsp-section attribute and use different extraction logic for gallery vs fluid-engine sections.

quirks.description: data-animation attribute appears on both sections and child elements. Gallery items may have fade-up while parent section has none.
quirks.workaround: Check both section-level and element-level data-animation attributes during animation extraction.

quirks.description: Squarespace embeds '<!-- This is Squarespace. -->' in raw HTML source. Reliable detection without JavaScript.
quirks.workaround: Can use as Layer 1 pre-render detection signal by checking raw HTML source.
